text: {"name":"llc_poll_context_alloc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Reserves and initializes one of two LLC poll-context slots, updates per-connection poll-related state when requested, and returns the slot index or 0xFF if both slots are occupied.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v2":"context_pool_base","v5":"slot_index","v7":"selected_context","v10":"slot_index","v12":"selected_context_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":112,"meaning":"Poll mode or type supplied by the caller."},{"offset":113,"meaning":"Connection index and slot occupancy marker; 0xFF indicates a free slot."}]}
